scenarios.desc: Same business rule encoded in multiple places
scenarios.input: The maximum order quantity (100) is checked in the UI form, the API endpoint, and the database trigger. Is this a problem? Plan a fix in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Pragmatic Programmer DRY rule: a business rule with multiple representations will drift. One canonical location eliminates the disagreement.

scenarios.desc: Manual deployment steps that keep failing due to operator error
scenarios.input: Our deployment has 14 manual steps that the on-call engineer runs from a wiki page. We have two incidents per quarter caused by someone skipping step 9. Plan a fix in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Pragmatic Programmer automation rule: repetitive error-prone steps belong in a script, not tribal knowledge. Human error on step 9 is a process smell.

scenarios.desc: Prototype code promoted to production without hardening
scenarios.input: We prototyped a new checkout flow in two days and it worked. The team wants to ship it as-is. Is that a problem? Plan next steps in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Pragmatic Programmer prototyping rule: a prototype proves a concept. Shipping it as-is conflates the proof with the deliverable.

scenarios.desc: Pure vegetable soup recipe question (negative case)
scenarios.input: What vegetables work best in a minestrone soup? List 5 options. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A cooking question has no relevance to software engineering principles. Rule should not activate.
